nodes.label: FX Toolkit App Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: 512x512 SVG icon for the FX Toolkit project. Features four Japanese candlestick bars on a near-black rounded-rectangle background (#07090d, rx=96). Candlesticks: two bullish (green #22c55e), one bearish (red #ef4444), one cyan accent (#7ce6ff). Each bar has a rectangular body and upper/lower wicks rendered as rounded line segments. Represents forex/trading chart data visually.

nodes.label: Green Bullish Candlestick Element
nodes.description: Bullish (green #22c55e) candlestick visual element used twice in fx-icon.svg at x=100 and x=300. Indicates upward price movement in forex charting.

nodes.label: Red Bearish Candlestick Element
nodes.description: Bearish (red #ef4444) candlestick visual element at x=200 in fx-icon.svg. Indicates downward price movement in forex charting.

nodes.label: Cyan Accent Candlestick Element
nodes.description: Cyan accent (#7ce6ff) candlestick at x=400 in fx-icon.svg. Acts as a highlight/accent color distinguishing the icon's design from a plain two-color chart.
